description:
Looking for a guilt-free dessert that’s creamy, delicious, and packed with protein? 🍨 This Keto High-Protein Chocolate Peanut Butter Ice Cream is a game-changer! With just a few simple ingredients, you can whip up a low-carb treat that satisfies your sweet tooth while keeping you on track with your keto or fitness goals.

In this video, I’ll walk you through the step-by-step process of making this rich and indulgent ice cream that’s perfect for anyone on a keto diet or looking for a high-protein dessert option. Let’s dive in!

------------

🕒 Time Stamps:
0:00 - Introduction to Keto High-Protein Chocolate Peanut Butter Ice Cream
0:45 - Ingredients
1:54 - Now's the time to add the protein
2:58 - Important Calorie Notes
3:33 - Churning and Peanut Butter add in
4:15 - Dish up!
4:35 - Results and thoughts
5:44 - Macros
6:28 - The end bit

--------------

🍦 Recipe Highlights:
 • Keto-friendly and low-carb
 • Packed with protein to support your fitness goals
 • Rich chocolate flavor with a peanut butter twist
 • Easy to make with a Ninja Creami too

------------

🔑 Keywords:
Keto ice cream, high-protein dessert, chocolate peanut butter ice cream, low-carb dessert, keto recipe, homemade ice cream, sugar-free dessert, protein ice cream recipe, keto chocolate ice cream, keto peanut butter ice cream

📌 Tags:
#KetoIceCream #HighProteinDessert #KetoDesserts #LowCarbRecipes #ChocolatePeanutButter #SugarFreeIceCream #HomemadeDesserts #HealthyEating

✨ Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more delicious recipes and keto tips! Let me know in the comments what flavor you’d like to see next. 🥜🍫
